LanguageData.TN_HeardNewsOnRadio.stages.0.label: Up to date
LanguageData.TN_HeardNewsOnRadio.stages.0.description: Heard the latest world news on the radio.
LanguageData.TN_RadioOperatorFocus.stages.0.label: Decoded world signal
LanguageData.TN_RadioOperatorFocus.stages.0.descripti: Spent time pulling a useful report out of the static.
LanguageData.TN_RadioMonitoringShift.stages.0.label: worked the radio desk
LanguageData.TN_RadioMonitoringShift.stages.0.descrip: Spent a focused shift sorting signals and chatter into something useful.
LanguageData.TN_NewsChatterConcerned.stages.0.label: heard worrying news
LanguageData.TN_NewsChatterConcerned.stages.0.descrip: The colony is talking about troubling news from beyond the walls.
LanguageData.TN_NewsChatterRumor.stages.0.label: heard unsettling rumors
LanguageData.TN_NewsChatterRumor.stages.0.description: Second-hand rumors are moving through the colony. Nobody knows what to believe yet.
LanguageData.TN_NewsChatterInformed.stages.0.label: briefed on world events
LanguageData.TN_NewsChatterInformed.stages.0.descript: Got a clearer picture of what is happening outside the colony.
LanguageData.TN_NewsChatterReassured.stages.0.label: heard reassuring news
LanguageData.TN_NewsChatterReassured.stages.0.descrip: Some news from outside was encouraging enough to lift the room.
LanguageData.TN_DiplomaticUpdate.stages.0.label: useful diplomatic briefing
LanguageData.TN_DiplomaticUpdate.stages.0.description: Clear information from abroad makes the world feel a little less opaque.
LanguageData.TN_DiplomatReturned.stages.0.label: returned from diplomacy
LanguageData.TN_DiplomatReturned.stages.0.description: Finished a diplomatic mission and came home with useful experience from abroad.
LanguageData.TN_DiplomatEvacuated.stages.0.label: evacuated from diplomatic post
LanguageData.TN_DiplomatEvacuated.stages.0.descriptio: The mission ended suddenly, and the return home was too close for comfort.
LanguageData.TN_ColonyPulseAnxiety.stages.0.label: tense news cycle
LanguageData.TN_ColonyPulseAnxiety.stages.0.descripti: Everyone keeps circling back to the same bad news. It is starting to wear on the colony.
LanguageData.TN_ColonyPulseRumor.stages.0.label: rumor mill running
LanguageData.TN_ColonyPulseRumor.stages.0.description: Too many stories are moving around without proof. Hard to tell signal from static.
LanguageData.TN_ColonyPulseConfidence.stages.0.label: steady briefing rhythm
LanguageData.TN_ColonyPulseConfidence.stages.0.descri: The colony has a better grip on outside events today. Reliable information helps.
LanguageData.TN_ColonyAdvisoryBriefed.stages.0.label: received colony advisory
LanguageData.TN_ColonyAdvisoryBriefed.stages.0.descri: The radio desk turned outside news into a clear colony advisory. It helps to know what the report actually means.
LanguageData.TN_HealthAdvisoryPrepared.stages.0.label: health advisory prepared
LanguageData.TN_HealthAdvisoryPrepared.stages.0.descr: The colony has clear medical instructions for an outside outbreak. That makes the risk feel more manageable.
LanguageData.TN_PublicHealthSickArrivals.stages.0.des: Visitors arrived showing symptoms from an outside outbreak. That makes the risk feel immediate.
LanguageData.TN_PublicHealthPreparedArrivals.stages.0: Sick visitors arrived, but the colony had medical instructions and supplies ready.
LanguageData.TN_TradeAdvisoryPrepared.stages.0.label: trade advisory prepared
LanguageData.TN_TradeAdvisoryPrepared.stages.0.descri: The colony has a practical plan for disrupted roads and strained supplies.
LanguageData.TN_WarNearby.stages.0.label: war nearby
LanguageData.TN_WarNearby.stages.0.description: Confirmed reports of fighting near our territory. Hard to focus with that going on.
LanguageData.TN_WarDistant.stages.0.label: distant conflict
LanguageData.TN_WarDistant.stages.0.description: Heard about a war breaking out somewhere out there. Unsettling news to wake up to.
LanguageData.TN_PlagueNearby.stages.0.label: plague spreading
LanguageData.TN_PlagueNearby.stages.0.description: A plague has been confirmed nearby. It's hard not to think about what that means for us.
LanguageData.TN_PlagueDistant.stages.0.label: plague reported
LanguageData.TN_PlagueDistant.stages.0.description: Reports of sickness spreading somewhere. Unpleasant to hear about even at a distance.
LanguageData.TN_CoupNearby.stages.0.label: political crisis nearby
LanguageData.TN_CoupNearby.stages.0.description: A coup's been reported close to us. Instability like that has a way of spreading.
LanguageData.TN_AllianceGoodNews.stages.0.label: good news from abroad
LanguageData.TN_AllianceGoodNews.stages.0.description: Encouraging news from the outside world. Helps to hear things aren't all bad out there.
LanguageData.TN_ProxyAction.stages.0.label: uneasy about our actions
LanguageData.TN_ProxyAction.stages.0.description: Heard our colony may be involved in something sensitive. Hard not to feel a bit uneasy about it.
LanguageData.TN_RumorDistressing.stages.0.label: disturbing rumors
LanguageData.TN_RumorDistressing.stages.0.description: Picked up some troubling rumors on the radio. Who knows if they're true, but they stick with you.
LanguageData.TN_WarEscalatesNearby.stages.0.label: war erupts nearby
LanguageData.TN_WarEscalatesNearby.stages.0.descripti: Open fighting has broken out between factions near our territory. The sound of it carries and so does the unease.
LanguageData.TN_FamineNearby.stages.0.label: famine strikes nearby
LanguageData.TN_FamineNearby.stages.0.description: People are starving in a faction near our colony. Hard not to think about what that means for supply lines and for them.
LanguageData.TN_PeaceRestored.stages.0.label: peace restored nearby
LanguageData.TN_PeaceRestored.stages.0.description: The fighting between nearby factions has stopped. Trade routes are reopening and the region feels a little safer to be in.
LanguageData.TN_EspionageNearby.stages.0.label: spy scandal nearby
LanguageData.TN_EspionageNearby.stages.0.description: A foreign spy network was exposed near our colony. It is hard not to wonder who else might be watching.
LanguageData.TN_EconomicCrisisNearby.stages.0.label: economic collapse nearby
LanguageData.TN_EconomicCrisisNearby.stages.0.descrip: A nearby faction's economy has collapsed. Supply chains are disrupting and prices are climbing.
LanguageData.TN_TechBreakthroughInspired.stages.0.des: Word of a technological breakthrough nearby has sparked fresh ideas. Maybe we can build on it.
LanguageData.TN_CultRiseUnsettling.stages.0.label: strange cult nearby
LanguageData.TN_CultRiseUnsettling.stages.0.descripti: A fanatical movement is spreading through the region. Its influence feels uncomfortably close to home.
LanguageData.TN_PirateRaidFear.stages.0.label: raiders hitting nearby
LanguageData.TN_PirateRaidFear.stages.0.description: Coordinated pirates are striking trade routes in the area. We could be next if they find us attractive.
LanguageData.TN_AncientSiteWonder.stages.0.label: ancient ruins found
LanguageData.TN_AncientSiteWonder.stages.0.descriptio: Pre-collapse ruins were found nearby. Whatever the old world was, part of it is still out there.
LanguageData.TN_EnvCatastropheNearby.stages.0.label: environmental disaster nearby
LanguageData.TN_EnvCatastropheNearby.stages.0.descrip: A toxic event has contaminated land near our colony. The long-term effects are unknown and that is troubling.
LanguageData.TN_ColonistCelebrity.stages.0.label: famous across the rim
LanguageData.TN_ColonistCelebrity.stages.0.descriptio: The whole region is saying my name. It is a strange and heady thing to be a legend.
LanguageData.TN_ColonistNotorious.stages.0.label: notorious across the rim
LanguageData.TN_ColonistNotorious.stages.0.descriptio: The whole region knows what I did, and not kindly. Knowing there is a price on my name sits heavy.
